notes: Street address resolved 2026-09-10: the congregation meets at 2727 S. Langley Avenue, Tucson AZ 85730 (cctworship.org/contact/); the P.O. Box 17388 / 85731 previously recorded is the mailing address only. Geocode reset to missing - run tools/geocode.py. Preacher confirmed from the church's own leadership page: Dr. Dale Briggs, titled 'Pastor - Teacher', pastor here since August 2007, D.Min. in expository preaching from The Master's Seminary. Bill Buntin and Larry Perry are lay elders, not preaching staff. Denomination: the church's own site states NO denominational affiliation - its doctrinal statement is generic conservative evangelical and reads Master's Seminary / dispensational rather than Restoration Movement, so the previous 'Christian Church / Churches of Christ' label is not supported by a primary source. It is listed in the Christian Standard (Restoration Movement) church directory, which may be where that label came from; the tradition field is left as restoration_churches_of_christ pending a better answer. Media: sermons are hosted on SermonAudio (broadcaster 'cctworship', 780+ sermons by Dale Briggs) and embedded on the church site; the site also links a SermonAudio live stream. No YouTube channel found. SermonAudio audio will need local transcription - there are no YouTube captions to pull.
